Different from the suggested 'Error' but a reasonable choice.

findings.problem: Glossary section 2 records es monitor -> monitorizacion, and the es style guide still carries no object/activity call, so the copy's object term has no recorded authority (glossary footnote 7 records exactly this split for hi). Round 1 raised the same point (es-chat-rd-m2) and recommended keeping the object word and recording the split; the word was kept and the guide is byte-identical (sha256 6546611...), so the recorded call is still missing. The copy itself is consistent: es uses the object term for monitors everywhere and uses no activity term at all (zero occurrences of monitorizacion in the es catalogues), so nothing else reads wrong.
findings.suggestion: Record in i18n/style-guides/es.md, under Locale calls: monitor (stored object, section heading and cancel copy) -> monitor; monitoring (activity) -> monitorizacion, mirroring glossary footnote 7's hi precedent. No catalogue change needed.
